title: What should play next?
intro: Suggestions come from your own listening and are matched to real tracks before you see them.

vibe.title: Describe a vibe
vibe.text: Free text: a mood, a moment, a mix of genres.

playlist.title: Based on a playlist
playlist.text: Finds tracks that fit an existing playlist.

form.label: Request
form.vibePlaceholder: Rainy evening, mellow indie, a bit of jazz, nothing too sad
form.example4: Something like my top artist but jazzier
form.playlistHint: Uses its artists and what you play most.
form.noPlaylists: You don't have any playlists to start from yet.
form.seedFailed: Couldn't read this playlist. Pick another one.
form.maxPlaysLabel: Skip tracks I've played more than
form.maxPlaysHint: Times. Leave empty to keep every track.
form.noteDemo: Demo uses pre-generated answers. Nothing you type is sent to an AI model.
form.noteDemoLive: Live AI is on in this demo: your text is sent to the AI model.
form.noteLive: Each run asks the AI model once, using a short summary of your last 6 months.

progress.title: Working on it…
progress.profile: Built your taste profile from {plays, plural, one {# play} other {# plays}}

results.heading: {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} · {title}
results.summary: Matched {matched} of {asked} · removed tracks don't get saved
results.filtered: {count, plural, one {# match was} other {# matches were}} left out by your filters.
results.reopened: An earlier run. Reasons aren't kept for earlier runs.
results.demoNotice: These are pre-generated suggestions from the demo catalog. Saving creates a playlist in your demo session.
results.unmatchedSummary: {count, plural, one {# suggestion couldn't be matched} other {# suggestions couldn't be matched}}
results.unmatchedHint: not found as tracks, so they were dropped
results.emptyBody: No suggestion matched a track that passes your filters. Loosen the filters or try a different request.
results.allRemovedBody: You removed every suggestion. Regenerate to get new ones.
results.added: Added {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} to “{name}”.
results.addedSkipped: Added {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} to “{name}”; {skipped, plural, one {# was} other {# were}} already there.
results.allPresent: Every track here is already in “{name}”.

saveDialog.title: Save as new playlist
saveDialog.description: Creates a new playlist in your Spotify library with the {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} in this list.

timeout.title: The model didn't answer
timeout.body: The AI provider timed out. Nothing was saved; try again.

provider.title: The AI provider returned an error
provider.body: Something went wrong on the provider's side. Nothing was saved; try again in a moment.

notConfigured.title: AI isn't set up
notConfigured.body: The server has no valid API key for the AI provider. Add it to the environment, then try again.

emptyAnswer.title: No suggestions came back
emptyAnswer.body: The model had nothing to suggest for this request. Try describing it differently.

invalid.title: Check your request
invalid.body: Something in the request wasn't valid. Adjust it and try again.

playlistMissing.title: Playlist not available
playlistMissing.body: That playlist is empty or no longer exists. Pick another one.

forbidden.title: Not available
forbidden.body: Your account doesn't have access to this feature.

unknown.title: Something went wrong
unknown.body: We couldn't finish this run. Try again.

rateLimited.title: That’s enough for today
rateLimited.body: You’ve used today’s AI suggestions. They come back tomorrow.

earlier.title: Earlier suggestions
earlier.empty: Your suggestion runs show up here, so you can open them again.
earlier.metaUnmatched: {count, plural, one {# track} other {# tracks}} · {unmatched} unmatched
earlier.loadFailed: Couldn't open this run. Try again.

demoReasons.unplayed: You play {artist} a lot, but this one hasn't come up yet.
demoReasons.deepCut: A {artist} song you've only played {plays, plural, one {once} other {# times}}.
demoReasons.familiar: Another one from {artist}, close to the songs you replay most.
demoReasons.neighbor: Fits the {genre} side of your listening, from an artist you play less often.
